HomePage.welcomeDescription: DEFAULTNAME serves over XX,XXX real estate professionals in DEFAULTSTATE. As a top-rated multiple listing service (MLS), we provide property information and innovative products.
HomePage.trackMarket: Track the {city} Market in Real Time

Estimates.locationDescription: Discover your {city} home's current market value with real-time data and comprehensive market insights. Track {city} real estate trends including average home prices, days on market, and active inventory levels across all neighbourhoods. Whether you're considering selling or simply want to understand what your home is worth in today's market, our {city} home valuation tool provides accurate estimates based on recent sales data and current market conditions. Get instant access to {city} housing statistics and see how your neighbourhood compares to the broader market.
Estimates.estimateFlowBannerTitle: How Do We Estimate Your Home's Value?

propertyTax.title: Property Tax
propertyTax.description: A key benchmark. Tax assessments help ground your estimate in real, municipality-backed data.

location.title: Location & Neighborhood
location.description: Local market trends and recent nearby sales are major drivers of home value.

propertyType.title: Property Type & Size
propertyType.description: Whether it's a condo or a detached home, the size of your home is a key factor to determine your home's value.

lotSize.title: Lot Size & Features
lotSize.description: Bigger lots and unique shapes like corner or pie lots often increase desirability.

age.title: Age & Condition
age.description: Newer and well-maintained homes tend to hold more value over time.

upgrades.title: Upgrades & Extras
upgrades.description: Renovations, modern finishes, finished basements, and upgraded appliances can significantly increase your home's worth.

maintenanceFees.title: Maintenance Fees
maintenanceFees.description: Lower monthly fees can make units more attractive and increase resale value.

exposure.title: Exposure & Amenities
exposure.description: A bright southern view and top-tier amenities like gyms or pools boost appeal.

extras.title: Extras
